title: Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged)
html:
This article is about the ranged version of the attack. For the melee version, see Rakish Sneak Attack (Melee).
Rakish Sneak Attack (Ranged) is a Swashbuckler rogue weapon action. This ability allows the rogue to exploit an enemy's distraction and deal extra damage to their vulnerable spots with ranged weapons.

Description

Deal extra damage to a foe you have  Advantage against. You can also use this attack without Advantage if there are no other combatants within 2 m (7 ft) of the target, or if you have an ally within that range.

You can't use this attack if you have  Disadvantage.

At higher levels

For every 2 Swashbuckler levels above 3, Rakish Sneak Attack deals an additional 1d6⁠⁠Weapon damage, up to 6d6 at level 11:

  • 3d6⁠⁠Weapon at level 5
  • 4d6⁠⁠Weapon at level 7
  • 5d6⁠⁠Weapon at level 9
  • 6d6⁠⁠Weapon at level 11

Notes

Bugs

  • The tooltip states 2 m (7 ft), but the actual distance is 1.5 m (5 ft).
  • This is usable against an enemy combatant regardless of how many additional enemies are near it as long as those additional enemies are not within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the attacker.
    • If an ally of the attacker is within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the attacker, but is not within 1.5 m (5 ft) of the target, this attack will not be usable.
    • The TargetConditions for an attack with Advantage erroneously references a Melee Weapon Attack, and as such this attack will not be usable even with Advantage if the above conditions are not also met.
  • Rakish Sneak Attack is able to apply twice on a single attack in real time outside of combat. This is done by directly using the Rakish action with sneak attack set to ask.
